statement: When you create your store, you can select a subscription plan based on your desired feature set and anticipated sales volume. BigCommerce offers plans that scale to fit your business's needs, whether you're just starting out or are ready for advanced features like stored payment methods, product filtering, or price lists.

BigCommerce pricing is designed to grow predictably with your business. GMV thresholds for each plan reflect the size of businesses within each tier, and moving into a higher-tier plan comes with access to additional features. Overage fees increase linearly, so costs remain proportional as your sales grow.
BigCommerce offers several store subscription plans, sized to fit your store’s sales volume or feature needs.

Our first three plans, which also offer self-service upgrades or downgrades, can be billed monthly or annually. Our Performance plan is a custom-priced plan designed for larger stores with more complex needs.
Core $39 per month $29 per month, billed annually
Growth $105 per month $79 per month, billed annually
Scale $399 per month $299 per month, billed annually
Performance N/A Custom pricing starting at $1,499 per month, billed annually

Each self-serve plan has a GMV threshold designed to reflect the size of business it supports. When your trailing 12-month Inclusive GMV exceeds your current plan’s threshold, your plan is automatically upgraded.

statement: Apps are integrations that can be used to extend the core functionality of BigCommerce. They can give you extra analytics, integrate with other platforms, help you run marketing, and a host of other features.

The App Marketplace allows you to easily search for apps and install them with a single click. Each listing provides you with features so you can determine if an app is right for your store. Although some apps may require a subscription to use, many offer a free trial period or they may be entirely free.
View a searchable list of your installed apps by going to Apps › My apps in the control panel. From the list, you can access app details, apply updates, and uninstall apps.
App developers are responsible for technical and billing support of their product.
Users initiate installation by clicking **Install**.
There are three visibility options for apps: **Draft**, **Unlisted**, and **Public**.
Draft | Apps registered in the [Developer Portal](https://build.bigcommerce.com/) but never submitted for approval
